def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    scores = np.where(valid, -np.power(rem + 1.0, 2.0) / (item + 1e-8), -np.inf)
    if len(bins) > 0:
        max_val = np.max(bins)
        empty_mask = (bins == max_val)
        scores = np.where(empty_mask, -50.0, scores)
    return scores

    valid = rem >= 0
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 and np.max(bins) > 0 else 1.0
